summary: DC Vote is documenting recent attacks on the District's local authority and describing the current state of statehood advocacy efforts, while the ACLU raises concerns about National Guard presence in the District. A senator has committed to prioritizing DC statehood, and advocates have marked the anniversary of a federal takeover as evidence of the urgency of statehood. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
